_comment: Metric library. 'column' is the header in the Wisehockey match statistics CSV. Metrics with 'goalkeeper': true use columns counted from the match events CSV instead (see _load_goalie_stats in content.py) and are ranked among goalkeepers only. Definitions follow 'wh_portal Data Dictionaries 2026.pdf' (section 9), rewritten in plain language. 'events' lists the kinds of match events behind a metric (goal, assist, shot, save, goal_against, shot_against, faceoff_win; hardest_shot = the single fastest shot), so the card detail page can list them and link to video. Metrics without 'events' cannot be traced to single events.

metrics.label: Goals
metrics.definition: How many times the player put the puck in the opponent's net.
metrics.source_definition: G — Number of goals scored by a player

metrics.label: Assists
metrics.definition: Credited when the player passed, shot or touched the puck in a way that set up a teammate's goal.
metrics.source_definition: A — Number of assists received from shooting, passing or deflecting the puck towards the scoring teammate or touching it in any other way which enabled a goal

metrics.label: Points
metrics.definition: Goals plus assists. The simplest measure of how many goals a player was directly involved in.
metrics.source_definition: P — Number of points received by a player for goals scored or assists earned

metrics.label: Shots
metrics.definition: How many shots the player took. More shots usually means more pressure on the opposing goalkeeper.
metrics.source_definition: S — Number of a player's shots

metrics.label: Hardest shot
metrics.definition: The speed of the player's fastest shot in the game, measured by puck tracking.
metrics.source_definition: S TOP — Player's hardest shot

metrics.label: Expected goals (xG)
metrics.definition: Every shot gets a probability of becoming a goal, based on distance, angle, passes before the shot, screens and the goalkeeper's position. xG adds those up: 0.60 xG means the player's chances were worth about 0.6 goals on average.
metrics.source_definition: xGsum — Sum of a player's all shot xG values

metrics.label: Top skating speed
metrics.definition: The fastest the player skated at any moment in the game.
metrics.source_definition: SPD TOP — Player's top speed (km/h)

metrics.label: Distance skated
metrics.definition: The total distance the player skated during the game. It reflects workload and ice time.
metrics.source_definition: DIST — Total distance a player traveled on the ice (m)

metrics.label: Time on ice
metrics.definition: How long the player was on the ice in total. Coaches give the most ice time to players they trust.
metrics.source_definition: TOI — Player's time on the ice in total

metrics.label: Blocked shots
metrics.definition: How many opponent shots the player stopped with their body or stick before they reached the goal. It is a defensive sacrifice.
metrics.source_definition: BKS — Number of shots blocked by a player

metrics.label: Faceoff win %
metrics.definition: Share of faceoffs (the puck drop that restarts play) the player won. Winning the faceoff gives your team the puck.
metrics.source_definition: FOW% — Faceoff win percentage (per a player's all faceoffs)

metrics.label: Pass success
metrics.definition: Share of the player's passes that reached a teammate.
metrics.source_definition: Pass% — Percentage of successful passes per a player's all passes

metrics.label: Successful passes
metrics.definition: How many of the player's passes reached a teammate.
metrics.source_definition: Passes — Successful passes per a player's all passes

metrics.label: Puck battles won
metrics.definition: How many times the player won a contested puck, a one-on-one fight for a loose puck.
metrics.source_definition: PCW — Number of a player's puck contest wins

metrics.label: Saves
metrics.definition: Shots on goal the goalkeeper stopped.
metrics.source_definition: Counted from match events: Shot events with ShotResult 'Saved' where the player is the goalkeeper

metrics.label: Shots on goal faced
metrics.definition: Shots that would have gone in without a save. More shots faced means a busier night in net.
metrics.source_definition: Counted from match events: Shot events with ShotResult 'Saved' or 'Goal' where the player is the goalkeeper

metrics.label: Shot attempts faced
metrics.definition: Every shot the opponent aimed at this goalkeeper's net, including shots that were blocked or missed.
metrics.source_definition: Counted from match events: all Shot events where the player is the goalkeeper

metrics.label: Save percentage
metrics.definition: Share of shots on goal the goalkeeper stopped.
metrics.source_definition: Saves divided by shots on goal faced, counted from match events

metrics.label: Average pressure reduction
metrics.definition: Average reduction in nearby opponents achieved by a completed pass. Compares opponents within 3 metres of the passer when the puck is released with opponents within 3 metres of the receiver shortly afterwards. Fewer nearby opponents means less pressure. Only completed passes with enough tracking information count; goalkeepers are excluded. The receiver's situation is estimated from the first available position reading within two seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined PBP using Wisehockey event snapshots; reception time is estimated, not directly observed.
metrics.technical_definition: Opposing skaters within 3 m at pass release minus those within 3 m of the receiver in the first later snapshot within 2 seconds. Only successful passes; goalkeepers excluded. Positive values indicate pressure relief. Missing observations are excluded.

metrics.label: Pressure-reducing passes
metrics.definition: Share of assessed passes that leave the receiver with fewer nearby opponents than the passer had. Compares opponents within 3 metres of the passer when the puck is released with opponents within 3 metres of the receiver shortly afterwards. Fewer nearby opponents means less pressure. Only completed passes with enough tracking information count; goalkeepers are excluded. The receiver's situation is estimated from the first available position reading within two seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined PBP using Wisehockey event snapshots; reception time is estimated, not directly observed.
metrics.technical_definition: Opposing skaters within 3 m at pass release minus those within 3 m of the receiver in the first later snapshot within 2 seconds. Only successful passes; goalkeepers excluded. Positive values indicate pressure relief. Missing observations are excluded.

metrics.label: Evaluated passes
metrics.definition: Number of completed passes with enough tracking information to compare pressure on the passer and receiver. Compares opponents within 3 metres of the passer when the puck is released with opponents within 3 metres of the receiver shortly afterwards. Fewer nearby opponents means less pressure. Only completed passes with enough tracking information count; goalkeepers are excluded. The receiver's situation is estimated from the first available position reading within two seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined PBP using Wisehockey event snapshots; reception time is estimated, not directly observed.
metrics.technical_definition: Opposing skaters within 3 m at pass release minus those within 3 m of the receiver in the first later snapshot within 2 seconds. Only successful passes; goalkeepers excluded. Positive values indicate pressure relief. Missing observations are excluded.

metrics.label: Average pass packing
metrics.definition: Average number of opponents bypassed per assessed pass, after subtracting the effect of backward passes. Counts opponents passed in the direction of the attacking goal. Their positions are judged when the pass is released, comparing how far forward the passer and receiver are. Forward passes add to the score; backward passes can subtract from it. Goalkeepers are excluded. The receiver's position is estimated from the first available position reading within two seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined longitudinal packing, with opponent positions frozen at pass release. Not a measure of passing lanes or defender movement.
metrics.technical_definition: Signed number of opposing skaters whose release-time x positions lie strictly between passer and reception positions. Forward bypasses are positive; backward passes restoring opponents ahead of the puck are negative. Goalkeepers excluded. Reception uses the first later snapshot within 2 seconds.

metrics.label: Total pass packing
metrics.definition: Total opponents bypassed through assessed passes, after subtracting the effect of backward passes. Counts opponents passed in the direction of the attacking goal. Their positions are judged when the pass is released, comparing how far forward the passer and receiver are. Forward passes add to the score; backward passes can subtract from it. Goalkeepers are excluded. The receiver's position is estimated from the first available position reading within two seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined longitudinal packing, with opponent positions frozen at pass release. Not a measure of passing lanes or defender movement.
metrics.technical_definition: Signed number of opposing skaters whose release-time x positions lie strictly between passer and reception positions. Forward bypasses are positive; backward passes restoring opponents ahead of the puck are negative. Goalkeepers excluded. Reception uses the first later snapshot within 2 seconds.

metrics.label: Positive-packing passes
metrics.definition: Share of assessed passes that move the puck beyond at least one opponent towards the attacking goal. Counts opponents passed in the direction of the attacking goal. Their positions are judged when the pass is released, comparing how far forward the passer and receiver are. Forward passes add to the score; backward passes can subtract from it. Goalkeepers are excluded. The receiver's position is estimated from the first available position reading within two seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined longitudinal packing, with opponent positions frozen at pass release. Not a measure of passing lanes or defender movement.
metrics.technical_definition: Signed number of opposing skaters whose release-time x positions lie strictly between passer and reception positions. Forward bypasses are positive; backward passes restoring opponents ahead of the puck are negative. Goalkeepers excluded. Reception uses the first later snapshot within 2 seconds.

metrics.label: Expected assists (xA)
metrics.definition: Total chance quality created by passes that set up shots. A completed pass that leads to a shot within four seconds earns the passer that shot's expected goals (xG): its estimated chance of becoming a goal. Only the last completed pass counts, and the opponents must not gain control before the shot. Shots without a chance estimate are left out.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined expected assists using Wisehockey shot xG and pass/control events.
metrics.technical_definition: The last successful pass to the shooter within four seconds before a shot receives its xG as expected assists, unless opponent possession intervenes. Each shot is credited once; missing xG is excluded.

metrics.label: Shots set up
metrics.definition: Number of shots set up by the player's completed passes. A completed pass that leads to a shot within four seconds earns the passer that shot's expected goals (xG): its estimated chance of becoming a goal. Only the last completed pass counts, and the opponents must not gain control before the shot. Shots without a chance estimate are left out.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined expected assists using Wisehockey shot xG and pass/control events.
metrics.technical_definition: The last successful pass to the shooter within four seconds before a shot receives its xG as expected assists, unless opponent possession intervenes. Each shot is credited once; missing xG is excluded.

metrics.label: Average xG of shots set up
metrics.definition: Average chance of scoring for shots set up by the player's passes. A completed pass that leads to a shot within four seconds earns the passer that shot's expected goals (xG): its estimated chance of becoming a goal. Only the last completed pass counts, and the opponents must not gain control before the shot. Shots without a chance estimate are left out.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined expected assists using Wisehockey shot xG and pass/control events.
metrics.technical_definition: The last successful pass to the shooter within four seconds before a shot receives its xG as expected assists, unless opponent possession intervenes. Each shot is credited once; missing xG is excluded.

metrics.label: Average chance quality after entry
metrics.definition: Average scoring-chance quality created by the team after the player brings the puck into the attacking zone. Add up the expected goals (xG) of the team's shots until the puck leaves the zone or play stops, including shots after winning the puck back. Entries without shots count as zero; entries with incomplete information are left out.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined KPI from Wisehockey blue-line crossings, team-relative directions and puck/shot events.
metrics.technical_definition: Average own-team shot xG generated per evaluated offensive entry. Opponent control inside the zone does not end the sequence; puck departure or stoppage does. Entries with missing shot xG or unknown sequence endings are excluded, not zero.

metrics.label: Total chance quality after entries
metrics.definition: Total expected goals (xG) from the team's shots following the player's assessed attacking-zone entries. Each shot is counted once, including a shot that becomes a goal. Count shots until the puck leaves the zone or play stops, including shots after winning the puck back.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined KPI from Wisehockey blue-line crossings, team-relative directions and puck/shot events.
metrics.technical_definition: Sum of BLCxG over fully evaluated offensive entries. Each shot credits at most one entry; Goal rows do not add xG again.

metrics.label: Evaluated offensive entries
metrics.definition: Number of times the player brings the puck into the attacking zone where the resulting play can be assessed through to its end. The end must be known, and all of the team's shots must have a scoring-chance estimate. An entry that produces no shots still counts.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined KPI from Wisehockey blue-line crossings, team-relative directions and puck/shot events.
metrics.technical_definition: Number of offensive entries with a known sequence ending and valid xG for every own-team shot. Completed sequences without shots count as zero BLCxG.

metrics.label: Controlled zone exits
metrics.definition: Number of times the player moves the puck out of the defensive zone while the team still controls it at the blue line. Control is judged at the crossing, without requiring possession for a set time afterwards.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined KPI from Wisehockey blue-line crossings, team-relative directions and puck/shot events.
metrics.technical_definition: Defensive zone crossings towards the opponent with PossessionMaintained. No additional possession-retention window is required.

metrics.label: Controlled exit share
metrics.definition: Share of assessed defensive-zone exits where the team still controls the puck at the blue line. Exits that lose possession or send the puck away without control count as unsuccessful. Exits whose outcome is unknown are left out.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined KPI from Wisehockey blue-line crossings, team-relative directions and puck/shot events.
metrics.technical_definition: Controlled exits divided by defensive exit attempts with a known crossing outcome. PossessionLost and PuckDumpedIn count as uncontrolled; None and missing outcomes are excluded.

metrics.label: Zone exit attempts
metrics.definition: Number of defensive-zone exit attempts attributed to the player with a known outcome: keeping control, losing possession, or sending the puck away without control.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined KPI from Wisehockey blue-line crossings, team-relative directions and puck/shot events.
metrics.technical_definition: Defensive zone exit attempts with PossessionMaintained, PossessionLost or PuckDumpedIn and an identified skater.

metrics.label: Passes intercepted
metrics.definition: Number of opponent passes the player cuts out anywhere on the ice. Only confirmed interceptions count; an unsuccessful opponent pass alone is not enough. Goalkeepers are excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Wisehockey PassResult=Intercepted; EventPrimaryPlayerId is the passer and EventSecondaryPlayerId the intercepting opponent.
metrics.technical_definition: Opponent passes explicitly marked Intercepted, credited to the identified secondary skater on the opposing team, across all zones. Successful and Failed passes do not count. Goalkeepers are excluded.
